review.posthog_relevance: Adds mirror service wiring and comparison infrastructure for HogWatcher, HogRateLimiter, Redis, and PushNotification, supporting potential failure recovery and consistency checks.
review.reason: Adds wiring for HogWatcher and HogRateLimiter mirrors and a HogWatcher mirror, plus a mirrorCompare function and runMirrorCall helper. This establishes the integration and comparison infrastructure, though the chunk lacks the full implementation of mirrorCompare and the setup of mirror services, preventing a tier 3 assessment. The change represents a substantive, bounded capability
review.uncertainty: Chunk does not include full implementation of mirrorCompare, complete setup of mirror services, or tests; cannot verify actual recovery behavior or systemic risk reduction.
